PARA.TITLE: Shift Lever Reverse Position Warning Device

ITEM.PTXT: A reverse position warning buzzer is installed in the combination meter assembly; when the shift lever is moved to the R position, the intermittent sound of the buzzer informs the driver that the vehicle is in reverse.
A shift lock system has been adopted to prevent incorrect operation of the shift lever.
The shift lock system is electric on all models, simplifying the construction.
A shift lock release button is provided on the shift lever housing so that the shift lock mechanism can be released manually when moving the vehicle by towing, etc., allowing for emergencies.

ENTRY.PTXT: Controls the operation of the shift lock solenoid based on various signals.
Manually releases the lock applied by the shift lock solenoid.
Outputs the brake signal to the shift lock computer.
Informs the driver by a buzzer that the vehicle is in reverse.

ITEM.PTXT: The shift lock computer prevents the shift lever from being moved out of the P position unless the brake pedal is depressed. For the shift lock mechanism, a shift lock unit integrating the shift lock solenoid, shift lock release switch, shift lock computer, etc. has been adopted, reducing the size of the shift lever assembly and simplifying its construction.
